copy.tagline: Line up four discs, lock out your opponent.
copy.description: Turn-based 1v1. Drop discs into the columns; the first to make a row of four across, down or diagonally wins. Two players on one device for now; online rooms and server validation come next.
controls: Two players take turns on one device; the disc at the top shows whose turn it is.
Click or tap a column and the disc drops to the bottom.
Line up four discs across, down or diagonally to win.
